sections.title: What can you host on Bonfiire?
text: Every event happens either in one place or along a route of checkpoints. Bonfiire is built for both.

items.label: Single location
items.title: One place, everyone together.
text: Most events happen in one spot: a meetup, a house party, an afternoon in the park. Pin the place, invite your people and welcome them in at the door.
items.imageAlt: A small group meeting up on a sunny autumn day

items.label: Multiple checkpoints
items.title: A route, stop by stop.
text: Some events move. Map out the route, put a host at each checkpoint, and participants collect a stamp at every stop.
items.imageAlt: Two friends checking the route on their phones

sections.title: What you get as an organizer.

items.title: E-tickets & check-in
items.text: Everyone who joins gets an e-ticket, checked in when they arrive.

items.title: Invites & sharing
items.text: Invite people directly or share the event link.

items.title: Participant management
items.text: See who's joined and keep your participant list in order.

items.title: Co-hosts
items.text: Bring in help to run the event with you.

items.title: One event chat
items.text: Communicate with all participants in one place, before and during the event.

items.title: Event album
items.text: Everyone's photos from the event, together in one place.

items.title: Route on a digital map
items.text: Map out multi-location routes, every venue in the order people will visit.

items.title: Checkpoints & stamps
items.text: Participants collect a stamp at every stop along the way.

items.title: Checkpoint hosts
items.text: Put someone in charge of each stop on the route.

items.title: Scoring & leaderboard
items.text: Score participants at the checkpoints and see who's leading.
